The patient's blood pressure is 103/75 mm Hg, pulse is 93/min, respiratory rate is 15/min, and temperature is 36.7°C (98.1°F). Physical examination reveals an anxious and fatigued-appearing young woman, but whose findings are otherwise within normal limits. What is the next and most important step in her management?
